name: GitHub
summary: Fetch repositories, archives, release assets and API data from GitHub into the artifact store; a token raises rate limits and reaches private repositories.

fields.name: access_token
fields.label: Access token
fields.help: A fine-grained token with read access only. Store it with ogun secrets set.

egress.note: Release assets and raw files are served from githubusercontent.com hosts; add the ones your workflow uses.

notes: Uses the builtin git@1 adapter for clones and acquire@1 for archives, release assets and API responses. The token is sent in a header from a secret reference and never appears in a URL or a log. Each repository carries its own licence; check it before use or redistribution.
